Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block [[Jokes#Alien speech and sounds|Alien speech and sounds]] ([[Wookiee Roar]] and [[MSE-6 'Mouse' Droid]]): Chewbacca, between Luke Skywalker and Han Solo in stormtrooper armour, roars down at the mouse droid in a Death Star corridor in ''Star Wars'' (1977); the droid squeals and flees.

Source: a frame from the film shown in the thumbnail of the YouTube video [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cLqNmMH4hsg Star Wars MSE-6 Mouse Droid - aka Death Star Toaster Droid] (Jennii Galaxy); Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250308031322/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cLqNmMH4hsg Internet Archive], 8 March 2025. Image file: [https://i.ytimg.com/vi/cLqNmMH4hsg/sd2.jpg sd2.jpg] (640 by 480 pixels); Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027171414/https://i.ytimg.com/vi/cLqNmMH4hsg/sd2.jpg Internet Archive], 27 October 2026 (SHA-256 of the archived file: 31f274232702ca0c8f9bcc4749318b4cf5b4c19efaf75e8d30fe01959019f062). Cropped to the picture (black bars removed), 616 by 278 pixels. SHA-256 of the uploaded file: 373e9966e6dc25c3d7c5a5fa38d50da223e08708b09e7f76d8ac10f52d6c3824.

It cannot replace the film or harm its market, and no free image of the scene exists.
